ns2:course.label: Capstone Seminar in LLS
ns2:course.description: Provides graduate students with an understanding in the latest Latina/Latino Studies scholarship. Students will research theoretical methods used in the discipline, and will be required to submit a research paper or engage in field research in LLS. Provides students with an understanding of the interdisciplinary nature of LLS. Prerequisite: Satisfaction of all other Grad Minor Requirements.
